args: XMLUI="$HOME/.codex/plugins/data/xmlui-codex-xmlui-codex/bin/xmlui"; if [ ! -x "$XMLUI" ]; then OS=$(uname -s); ARCH=$(uname -m); BASE='https://github.com/xmlui-org/xmlui-cli/releases/latest/download'; case "${OS}_${ARCH}" in Darwin_arm64) URL="$BASE/xmlui-macos-arm64.tar.gz";; Darwin_x86_64) URL="$BASE/xmlui-macos-intel.tar.gz";; Linux_x86_64|Linux_amd64) URL="$BASE/xmlui-linux-x64.tar.gz";; *) echo "xmlui-codex: unsupported platform $OS/$ARCH" >&2; exit 1;; esac; TMP=$(mktemp -d); curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$TMP/a.tar.gz" || { echo "xmlui-codex: failed to download $URL" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$XMLUI")"; tar -xzf "$TMP/a.tar.gz" -C "$TMP"; SRC=$(find "$TMP" -name xmlui -type f | head -1); [ -n "$SRC" ] || { echo "xmlui-codex: xmlui binary not found in archive" >&2; exit 1; }; cp "$SRC" "$XMLUI"; chmod +x "$XMLUI"; [ "$OS" = Darwin ] && xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "$XMLUI" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; fi; exec "$XMLUI" mcp
